runs: >x< Premium is our premium subscription service that elevates quality conversations on the platform.

>x< Premium is an opt-in, paid subscription that offers additional features* to improve your experience. >x< Premium has three tiers: Basic, Premium, and Premium+, with more features available in each higher tier.
Includes essential Premium features like editing posts, longer posts and longer video uploads, reply prioritization, text formatting, bookmark folders, custom app icons, and more.

Includes all Basic features plus a checkmark, reduced ads, access to apply for Original Content Rewards and Creator Subscriptions, larger reply prioritization, ID verification, Media Studio, and increased usage limits on

Includes all Premium features with additional benefits like SuperGrok access, Grok Bot, no ads anywhere on >x<, largest reply prioritization, Radar Search, and Articles. Occasional promoted content may appear.
The complete list of the features is here.
Subscribe now with localized pricing starting at $3/month or $32/year (plus any tax, e.g. VAT, and your payment method fees) on Web in available countries. Click here for pricing information.

All >x< Premium features associated with each tier will be available immediately except the blue checkmark, which will appear on eligible profiles subscribed to the Premium or Premium+ tiers after a review to ensure subscribed accounts meet all eligibility criteria.

There are two additional variations to the standard version of >x< Premium: Premium Business and Premium Organizations, which are services for businesses, governments, multilateral orgs, and nonprofits on >x< that come with a gold, grey and affiliate badges, VIP support, and more features for organizations.
Features

Premium features offer subscribers a way to enhance and customize their experience. These powerful controls are designed to help personalize your >x< experience, and provide early access to our newest features before they’re available to more people. Share your feedback via @Premium.
Premium subscriptions include a number of features* to improve your experience. Feature availability varies by the tier of Premium that you subscribe to. Some of these features include:
Features available to every Premium tier:

This highly requested feature gives you a 1 hour window to make a limited number of changes to published posts. Use it to make updates, tag someone, or reorder the media you attached. Edit post currently only applies to original posts and quotes.

Want to post more than 280 characters? Longer posts allow subscribers to post up to 25,000 characters. You can also compose longer posts in a quote or reply. Standard functionality like posting media, creating polls, and using hashtags still apply. Everyone will be able to read longer posts, but only Premium subscribers can create them.
Share more content with your followers. Premium subscribers can upload videos up to ~3 hours long and up to 8GB file size (1080p) (on x.com and >x< for iOS only).
As a Premium subscriber, you can create a community on >x< to connect with people who share similar interests.
Features available only to Premium and Premium+ tiers:
Get verified with a blue checkmark next to your name. The blue checkmark will appear on eligible profiles after a review to ensure subscribed accounts meet all eligibility criteria.

Earn money by creating original content on >x<. Original Content Rewards program is available globally to creators who meet the eligibility requirements. Payouts are calculated based on qualified impressions from Premium users with your content on >x<. Learn more about Original Content Rewards

Earn a living on >x< by letting anyone subscribe to you for monthly content. Subject to eligibility requirements. See the “Monetization” tab on x.com or the mobile app for more details. Learn more about Creator Subscriptions
As an >x< Premium subscriber, you can gift >x< Premium or Premium+ to anyone who isn’t yet subscribed – as a little treat. Learn more about Premium gifting

Premium tier subscribers see approximately 50% fewer ads in the For You and Following Timelines. As you scroll, you will see approximately twice as many organic or non-promoted posts placed in between promoted posts or ads. There may be times when there are more or fewer non-promoted posts between promoted posts. The reduced ads feature does not apply to promoted content elsewhere on >x<, including but not limited to ads on profiles, ads in post replies, Amplify Video ads, promoted events in Explore, promoted trends, and promoted accounts to follow.

Subscribers to the Premium+ tier will enjoy an ad-free experience across most areas of >x<, including the For You timeline, Following timeline, post replies, and profiles, ensuring a smoother and more uninterrupted content experience. Premium+ subscribers may occasionally encounter sponsored content.
Premium and Premium+ subscribers will have access to this feature after their account has been reviewed for eligibility and the blue checkmark has been applied.
Once verified, accounts can reply to posts which are limited to replies from verified accounts only.
Verify your account by providing a government-issued ID to protect your account against impersonation. Receive an “ID verified” label on your profile.
Manage the images and videos you've uploaded to >x< with studio.x.com. Learn more about Media Studio. This feature is not available to Basic tier subscribers.
Articles is a new way to share long form written content on >x<. Publishing Articles is a feature limited to Premium subscribers.
*Not all features available on all platforms and locations. Premium features may change periodically/from time to time as we keep improving the service.
Only for Premium+ Tier :

Higher limits on the latest Grok models so you can keep going, plus access Grok Bot — AI teammates that work in the background, signs into your apps, and actually get jobs done. You also get Imagine for videos and images, voice mode, and more.
View multiple configurable timelines simultaneously which can refresh in realtime, advanced search, add contributors and admins to your account, and more with >x< Pro.
Availability

New subscriptions to Premium are available globally on web, iOS, or Android. Not all features are available on all platforms. We may also impose waiting periods for new accounts in the future at our discretion, and without notice.

>x< reserves the right without notice to remove your blue checkmark at any time in its sole discretion without offering you a refund, including if you violate our Terms of Service or if your account is suspended.

q: What is >x< Premium?

runs: >x< Premium is an opt-in, paid subscription that offers additional features to improve your experience on >x<. >x< Premium has three tiers: Basic, Premium, and Premium+, with more features available in each tier.

q: Where do I sign up?

runs: To subscribe on web,
or go to x.com and select "Premium" from the side navigation. If you haven’t already, you’ll be prompted to verify your phone number. Confirm subscription payment.

To subscribe on iOS or Android, go to the profile menu > Premium. If you haven’t already, you’ll be prompted to verify your phone number. Follow the in-app purchase instructions to complete your subscription.

>x< accounts that haven’t been active within the last 30 days or that have changed their profile photo, display name, or username (aka @handle) within the previous 3 days may also be unable to sign up. Subscribers will also need a verified phone number. We are working on an updated process for new >x< accounts in order to help minimize impersonation risks and may impose and change waiting periods for new accounts without notice.

q: How much does Premium cost?

runs: Premium subscriptions are paid on a monthly or annual basis on web, iOS, or Android. Pricing is as follows:
Basic: Starts at $3/month or $32/year on web (or your local pricing)
Premium: Starts at $8/month or $84/year on web (or your local pricing)
Premium+: Starts at $40/month or $395/year on web (or your local pricing)
If Premium is available for purchase for you, you’ll find the regional currency price information on web and in-app on iOS and Android. Learn more about plans and pricing in available countries here.

q: How do I switch tiers?

runs: Upgrading and downgrading is currently only supported on iOS and web. How upgrading and downgrading works per platform is outlined below:

, if you upgrade to a higher priced tier, you will receive a partial, prorated refund for the remainder of your previous subscription if you switch tiers from the platform where you were previously subscribed, i.e., iOS. If you downgrade to another tier, your subscription and the associated features will remain through the end of the current billing cycle, and then switched to the new subscription tier. When downgrading, you will not receive a refund for any portion of your previous subscription, unless required by law. When downgrading, you will be charged for the price of the new tier starting at the end of your current billing cycle.

, when you upgrade to a higher-priced tier, your remaining credit from your current billing cycle will be applied to the new tier’s cost, and you’ll be charged the difference immediately. The switch takes effect right away, and your billing will adjust to the new tier’s cycle. When you downgrade, your current plan remains active until your current billing cycle ends, then switches to the new tier with its updated rate. You won’t receive a refund for your current billing cycle, even after downgrading, unless required by law.
Upgrading your subscription on the same day will not affect your creator payouts.

q: Are refunds available on Premium subscriptions?

runs: All subscriptions are non-refundable, unless required by law. That includes subscriptions linked to >x< accounts that have been suspended, or that you have lost access to for any other reason. This also includes situations where certain subscription features are temporarily or permanently unavailable.

However, only in the case you upgrade to a higher priced tier on iOS, you will receive a partial, prorated refund for the remainder of your previous subscription if you switch tiers from the platform where you were previously subscribed, i.e., iOS. If you upgrade to a higher priced tier on web, credit for the remainder of your previous subscription will go towards your account and automatically be applied to future payments if you switch tiers from the platform where you were previously subscribed, i.e., web.

q: What kinds of features are included in Premium?

runs: An active Premium subscription offers additional features to improve your experience on >x<. For a full list of features, see here. The features included in Premium are subject to change at any time as we continue to improve the service.

q: How does prioritized ranking work?

runs: We strive to show you the content that we think you’d be most interested in and contributes to the conversation in a meaningful way, such as content that is relevant, credible, and safe. Now, people on >x< will see a slight preference for replies from verified accounts over other replies. We’re currently testing the levels at which we prioritize content from Premium subscribers relative to the other factors we consider in conversation rankings.

q: What is the difference between the previous legacy blue checkmark and a checkmark obtained through an >x< Premium subscription?

runs: Previously, the blue checkmark indicated active, notable, and authentic accounts of public interest that were independently verified based on

Now the blue checkmark means the account has an active subscription to >x< Premium. Accounts that receive the blue checkmark as part of a >x< Premium subscription will not undergo review to confirm that they meet the active, notable and authentic criteria that was used in the previous process.

q: What is >x< Premium Business?

runs: Premium Business is a subscription for businesses on >x< which comes with a gold checkmark, affiliation badges, VIP support, impersonation defense and more.

q: What is >x< Premium Organization?

runs: Premium Organizations is a subscription for governments and nonprofits on >x< which comes with a grey checkmark, affiliation badges, VIP support, impersonation defense and more.

q: What does the affiliation badge mean?

runs: Through Premium Business and Premium Organizations, organizations can affiliate other accounts with their account. Affiliated accounts receive a label with the image from the organization's profile picture.

q: Which tier of Premium will affiliates of a Premium Business or Organization receive?

runs: All Premium Business and Premium Organization accounts, as well as their affiliates, will receive Premium+ included with their main subscription. This also includes access to SuperGrok, xAI’s Premium subscription for the Grok web and mobile app.

q: What do the gold and grey checkmarks mean? What is the difference between the blue and the gold and grey checkmarks?

runs: The gold checkmark indicates that an account is an official business or non-profit through Premium Business. The grey checkmark indicates that an account is a governmental or multilateral organization on >x< through Premium Organizations. The blue checkmark indicates an account has subscribed to Premium, and may represent an individual or an organization.

q: Is dedicated support a premium feature of Premium?

runs: Premium subscribers receive dedicated support for subscription-specific issues, only. That could look like help with managing a Premium subscription, how to access your Premium account or settings, and Premium enrollment issues. Other issues could include troubleshooting special features only available to subscribers.

q: Will subscribers receive preference when receiving account support?

runs: Our goals include providing the best customer support in our industry. We’re committed to treating everyone fairly and equitably. The
won’t apply differently to subscribers.

q: Can subscribers change their display names and user names?

runs: Once subscribed to Premium, changes to your profile photo, display name, or username (@handle) will result in the loss of the blue checkmark until the account is validated as continuing to meet our requirements, and no further changes will be allowed during this review period. Learn more about checkmark requirements

q: Will subscribers receive different support for enforcement issues like account blocks?

runs: We are committed to making >x< a safe place for everyone to participate in the public conversation. That’s why policy enforcement issues and reports by subscribers will continue to be handled by existing enforcement teams, under the current review process.

q: Does this mean the free version of >x< is going away?

runs: Free >x< isn’t going away. >x< Premium simply offers an opt-in layer of customization for your >x< experience.

q: Is Premium ad-free?

runs: The Basic tier does not offer reduced ads on >x<.
Premium tier subscribers will receive approximately 50% fewer ads in their For You and Following Timelines.
Both Basic and Premium subscribers will still see the normal amount of ads in other areas of the platform, such as replies, profiles, the Explore tab, and more.

Subscribers to the Premium+ tier will enjoy an ad-free experience on >x<, ensuring a smoother and more uninterrupted content experience. Premium+ subscribers may occasionally encounter sponsored content. For example, Premium+ subscribers may still see branded notification offerings like “like-to-remind.”

q: How do I pause or cancel my Premium subscription?

runs: If you ever need to cancel, you can manage your subscription from your settings on the platform where you subscribed. Your Premium features will expire at the end of your billing cycle.
To avoid further charges, cancel your Premium subscription at least 24 hours before the auto-renewal period. Canceling won’t give you a refund for amounts already paid.

Note: If you subscribe to Premium and cancel your subscription, your blue checkmark will remain until the end of the subscription term you paid for, unless your account is suspended or the blue checkmark is otherwise removed by >x< for any reason.

q: Why did >x< make this change to Premium and verification?

runs: This is one important step we’re taking to improve the quality of conversations on >x<. These changes are designed to reduce fake, untrustworthy accounts, and promote a higher quality platform where people can join and engage safely on our platform.

q: Do I have to purchase a Premium subscription to get the blue checkmark?

runs: Yes. You must subscribe to Premium, Premium+, or become an affiliate of a Premium Business to get a blue checkmark.*
*All >x< Premium features will be available immediately except the blue checkmark, which will appear on eligible profiles after a review to ensure subscribed accounts meet all eligibility criteria.

q: Why hasn’t my blue checkmark appeared yet?

runs: Most Premium features will be available immediately except the blue checkmark, which will appear on eligible profiles after a review to ensure subscribed accounts meet all eligibility criteria.

q: Will I get a refund for my monthly subscription that I paid for legacy Blue before the Premium changes?

runs: Premium subscriptions are non-refundable, except where required by law. Read more here.
